response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with nearly two decades of software experience, but his background is fundamentally misaligned with this role. The position requires SoC and IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/accelerator architecture, and deep-learning performance analysis — none of which appear in his resume. His closest relevant experience (low-latency DLang services and some embedded/robotics work) is tangential, and there is no evidence of hardware architecture, AI workload optimization, or performance modeling at the silicon level.
strengths: 18+ years of broad software engineering experience, meeting years-of-experience thresholds
Some systems-level and low-latency experience (DLang async I/O services handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, open-source contributions, teaching, and community involvement
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/AI accelerator workload background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product development, not principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI/deep-learning workload or GPU expertise
General seniority and systems programming exposure
